items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: They said, “Look, I’ve been working all week long on this tune.” Oh, Billy Foulkes.

ctx.x: Yeah. Because my horses say, “Now look” – and some of them are watching their watch. They say, oh. They say, “Now, he’s through.” Like, if I play two notes, and I set that horn down, they say, “He’s through.” It’s horses time. Really. I mean, cats will come from England. A couple cats come from London and said – the time was winding down – they said, “Look. We got to play.” I said, “We thought that you called us. We met you when you come in.” I said, “I thought you was going to come up and play.” They said, “No.”…
